annotations.text:
MaiKnowledge LLP business card, 3.5 x 2 in (96 px/in artboards). Front: white ground, primary #0B5B4A, black #111111. Back: deep green #0A2F26 ground, white and mint #5FD3B3 type; WardSynQ and StewardMD are the supplied artwork with only the fill colour changed for the dark ground (shapes untouched). QR carries a small centre infinity and still decodes at 150 px.
Placeholder: the blue cursive "nowledge" is set in a stand-in script face because the original cursive artwork was not supplied.
